notablePrerequisites: You control permanents that can tap to add at least {12}{U}{U}{R}{R}.
description:
Cast Reality Spasm by paying {7}{U}{U}, targeting seven permanents you control.
Holding priority, Cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Reality Spasm.
Resolve the Reality Spasm copy, untapping seven permanents you control.
Repeat from step 2.
